tool_input.command: cd "C:/visual projects/alpha/tools/compute"; git checkout p12-r2-expo.py; sed -i 's/^rep(.G95 = .,.*$/rep("FIELDS = ", "FAMS_M = (\\"g92\\", \\"g93\\", \\"g94\\", \\"g87\\") + ((\\"g95\\",) if WITH_G95 else ())\\nFIELDS = ")/' ../../tmp-tk135/p2.py; grep -n "FAMS_M" ../../tmp-tk135/p2.py

cd "C:/visual projects/alpha/tools/compute"; git show HEAD:tools/compute/p12-r2-expo.py > p12-r2-expo.py
cat > ../../tmp-tk135/p2.py <<'PYEOF'
f="p12-r2-expo.py"
s=open(f,encoding="utf-8").read()
def rep(a,b,cnt=1):
    global s
    assert a in s,a
    s=s.replace(a,b,cnt) if cnt else s.replace(a,b)
rep('Запуск на сервере счёта: p12-r2-expo.py /data/p12r2"""','Запуск на сервере счёта: p12-r2-expo.py /data/p12r2 [--g95]\n--g95 (TK-120/TK-135, бывшая копия p12-r3-expo.py): ещё и g95-sw3 (m = min(1, N_ref/N_peak), как g94/g87), для волны a TK-115; без флага — как было."""')
rep('("g92", "g93", "g94", "g87")','FAMS_M',0)
rep('O = sys.argv[1]\n','O = sys.argv[1]\nWITH_G95 = "--g95" in sys.argv[2:]\n')
rep('FIELDS = ','G95 = "ladder3x0..0.0409sw3-pct2-tr1x1-14400-ttl1800"\nFAMS_M = ("g92", "g93", "g94", "g87") + (("g95",) if WITH_G95 else ())\nFIELDS = ')
rep('def fam_of(form, base):\n','def fam_of(form, base):\n    if WITH_G95 and form == G95:   # TK-120: g95-sw3 — вход другого веса, база B1 (sw2) того же сигнала\n        return "g95"\n')
open(f,"w",encoding="utf-8",newline="\n").write(s)
PYEOF
python ../../tmp-tk135/p2.py && python -m pyflakes p12-r2-expo.py; grep -n "FAMS_M\|WITH_G95" p12-r2-expo.py | cut -c1-110
